name: Owlright, Owlright, Owlright (StriX Launch 13)
location_str: Rocket Lab LC-1B @ Rocket Lab Launch Complex 1, NZL
slot_a_text: It has already slipped twice. The current time was set 6 days ago and has held since. The window is instantaneous, so it goes on time or not at all.
slot_b_text: Rocket Lab's 18th launch of the year, 97th all time. Their year has run at a launch every couple of weeks. Electron is on a 55-flight success streak.
description: Synthetic aperture radar satellite for Japanese Earth imaging company Synspective.
rocket_fact: Liquid Hydrogen fuel is so cold (-423°F) that it would instantly freeze air into a solid block of nitrogen ice.
